# Celestial Synthesis

> Celestial Synthesis is a software company website for teams evaluating the company, its product FlowR, and ways to get in touch.

Celestial Synthesis builds reliable, scalable software products and solutions. The main product highlighted on this site is FlowR, a local-first tool for recording and replaying guided browser workflows.

Important notes:

- The primary public company information is on the main website pages listed below.
- FlowR is linked from this site but is hosted separately at `flowr.celestialsynthesis.com`.
- Contact for sales, demos, and partnerships: contact@celestialsynthesis.com.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://celestialsynthesis.com/): Overview of the company, featured product, and primary calls to action.
- [About](https://celestialsynthesis.com/about): Background on the company and its software philosophy.
- [Products](https://celestialsynthesis.com/products): Product overview and links to publicly available offerings.
- [Contact](https://celestialsynthesis.com/contact): Contact details for collaboration, demos, and business inquiries.

## Products

- [FlowR](http://flowr.celestialsynthesis.com/): Record and replay guided browser workflows with step repair, sharing, and export support.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://celestialsynthesis.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of indexable pages on the main website.
- [Robots](https://celestialsynthesis.com/robots.txt): Crawl guidance for automated agents.
